challenge give a sample mean of 79.8 minutes and an unbiased variance estimate of 9.966 minutes .

text: A biologist is studying the effect of nutrients on the heights to which plants grow. A random sample of
24 similar young plants is divided into two equal groups A and B. The plants in group A are fed with
nutrients and water and the plants in group B are given only water. After four weeks, the height, in cm,
of each plant is measured and the results are as follows.
The biologist decides to carry out a test at the 5% significance level to test whether the nutrients have
resulted in an increase in growth.
